entities.name: Andrej Kravárik
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrej Kravárik is a Slovak-Greek former volleyball player and current coach. He spent the biggest part of his playing career at Iraklis Thessaloniki, where he enjoyed great success. He was also coach of the Slovakia men's national volleyball team.
